[[Category:Tranquility Cemetery, Tranquility, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
Nancy was born 20 April 1780 in Rockbridge, Virginia. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosana Barclay]].  On 26 April 1804 she married [[McClelland-2291]] in Rockbridge, Virginia.<ref>Nancy Glasgow in the Virginia, U.S., Select Marriages, 1785-1940</ref>. Nancy died in 1806.<ref>Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), 34</ref> 
=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosanna Barclay]] identifies '''Nancy Glasgow''' among their ten children. This family reconstruction agrees with the migration and sibling evidence summarized on Robert's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.
